name: Beiruul
desc:
Beiruul is a Redwood Gremor NPC, a resident of [Meteor Isle](location:meteor_isle), she wants to take revenge on the Central Authority for the constant harassment they enact and the looming threat they pose to her people; choosing the correct dialogue responses will begin the Navae's Retribution sidequest.

During the Navae's Retribution quest, she will fight alongside the player to defeat several Authority Peacekeepers and Authority Officers.
additional_info:
-   Gripping Beiruul will reduce your reputation with the Children of Navae.
-   Similar to Polis and Zana, when spawning as an NPC her Gremor variant, face and horns will change into a random variant.
